initial_conditions: An empty unsigned studio on Debian ARM64 in a Sway Wayland session. The two-slot pocket is in millimetres and the two-fabric Harbor shirt is in metres.
actions: Use the GTK chooser to select the pocket. Choose millimetres, import and save. Undo, save, redo and save. Reopen in a fresh process and export OBJ.
Import Harbor into a third empty studio with units set to metres. Save and export OBJ. Close each process and stop the guest.

From the repository root run python3 -B parity/reports/artifacts/debian-wayland-editable-obj-20261120/check_native.py parity/reports/artifacts/debian-wayland-editable-obj-20261120 . and compare with GEOMETRY.json.
expected_outcomes: Undo restores the empty document. Redo and reopen preserve editable construction. Pocket dimensions are 0.240 × 0.360 m, area is 0.0756 m² and three boundary loops total 1.74 m. The two Harbor panels retain their source positions, colors and 0.5923 m² each.
